payload.name: Canvas Companion Lens v1
payload.what: A JIT adapter that lets DOGG's verified world/<tick> telemetry be summoned as four visible, interactive companions inside any single-file HTML canvas world (first proven in kody-w/localFirstTools' Quantum Worlds / Portal Hub). Every companion's content is a real, hash-verifiable slice of the world dimension - never fabricated flavor text.

builder.local_action: invokes the host world's own save/export function, if one exists

guardian.local_action: monitors local FPS and the host's own live peer-presence signal

payload.protocol: Fetch world/<tick>.json + its frame_hash, recompute the hash client-side (rapp/1 H(space,v) = sha256(space+'\n'+canonical(v))), render only if it verifies.
payload.feedback: Adapter learnings (which selectors/hooks worked in a given host medium) are meant to be written back here as new payload fields on later frames, so the next medium doesn't re-derive the same adaptation from scratch.
